item.title: Version 1.8.0-beta (90)
item.description:
Trails RG Studio 1.8.0-beta

Build 90

  • Adjust opens as a menu. Looks is one screen. Light, Color, Curve, HSL, FX, and Mask are separate.
  • Color opens its own list.
  • Each slider has its name. On a phone the sheet stays shorter so the photo keeps more of the screen.
